setup.zh: 水合上了。雷泽安静得能听见桑叶落。大野泽的鱼沉回水里，渡工的船开了。
setup.en: The water closes. Lake Lei is so quiet you can hear a mulberry leaf fall. The fish of Daye sink back into the water; the ferries sail.

recap.zh: 雷泽安静得能听见桑叶落。第三鼎在东边，海岱之间。
recap.en: Lake Lei grew so quiet you could hear mulberry leaves fall. The third cauldron lay east, between the sea and Mount Tai.

text.zh: 第三鼎的气息在东边——青州，海岱之间。
text.en: The third cauldron's breath lies east — Qing, between the sea and Mount Tai.

exits.means: rests, ends the chapter, asks what comes next

text.zh: 今日到此为止。青州的路，开的时候我会告诉你。
text.en: That is all for today. When the road to Qing opens, I will tell you.
